evidence.statement: Q2 2026 revenue was $2.8923B, up 19% YoY; da Vinci procedures were approximately 889k, up 15%, and Ion procedures approximately 47.9k, up 36%.
At June 30, 2026 the da Vinci installed base was approximately 11,710 systems, up 12% YoY; Ion installed base was approximately 1,096, up 21%.
Q2 2026 included 246 da Vinci 5 placements out of 468 total da Vinci placements; the global da Vinci 5 installed base was 1,710, of which 136 were outside the U.S.
Q2 instruments/accessories plus service revenue was $2.2073B, approximately 76.3% of total Q2 revenue; this is a recurring-like economic mix rather than contractual recurring revenue.

254 of 468 Q2 da Vinci placements, about 54.3%, were under operating leases; 131 were usage-based. Leasing strengthens installed-base relationships but shifts more capital onto Intuitive's balance sheet.
Q2 2026 GAAP gross margin was 67.8% versus 66.3% a year earlier; GAAP operating income was $971.9M, up 31% YoY.
H1 2026 OCF was $1.9729B versus $1.2970B in H1 2025; PPE purchases were $215.9M versus $271.9M.

TTM mechanical FCF is approximately $3.2224B using OCF less PPE purchases. This is a diagnostic proxy and not a fully normalized owner-earnings measure because leasing assets, inventory transfers, SBC and growth versus maintenance capex require interpretation.
evidence.method: FY2025 + H1_2026 - H1_2025 for OCF and PPE, then OCF - PPE

evidence.statement: TTM income-statement SBC is approximately $839.3M; subtracting it once from mechanical FCF gives a conservative owner-FCF diagnostic of approximately $2.3831B. Capitalized SBC is not separately re-subtracted to avoid double counting before inventory/amortization tracing.
Cash, cash equivalents and investments were $8.6255B at June 30, 2026; total liabilities were $2.5789B and the filing did not identify material borrowings.

Intuitive repurchased 3.2M shares for $1.5065B in H1 2026 at an average $475.67 per share; Q2 average was $438.68. This is materially above the September 9 reference price of $353.24 and is a capital-allocation monitoring point, not proof of value destruction by itself.
Q2 2026 basic weighted-average shares were 354.1M versus 358.5M a year earlier; diluted weighted-average shares were 357.3M versus 364.1M. Current evidence does not show persistent net dilution.

On March 1, 2026 Intuitive acquired da Vinci and Ion distributors serving Italy, Spain, Portugal, Malta, San Marino and related territories for approximately $533.1M cash, moving those markets to direct distribution.

For FY2026 management expects da Vinci procedure growth of 13.5%-15.5%, closer to the midpoint; non-GAAP gross margin 68%-69%, including about a 1% revenue tariff headwind; and non-GAAP operating expense growth of 11%-13%.

Johnson & Johnson received U.S. FDA De Novo authorization for OTTAVA on July 22, 2026 for multiple upper-abdominal general-surgery procedures, creating a new credible U.S. soft-tissue robotic competitor after the Q2 reporting date.
Medtronic's Hugo received U.S. FDA clearance for urologic procedures in December 2025 and in June 2026 Medtronic submitted 510(k)s for U.S. general and gynecologic indications.
CMR's Versius platform has U.S. FDA clearance and is pursuing additional indications, confirming that multi-platform competition is becoming clinically relevant rather than hypothetical.
FDA classified the 8 mm SureForm 30 Gray Reload recall as Class I; the identified issue was potential incomplete staple lines. The recall remained open in the FDA database at the reviewed date.

FDA also lists multiple 2026 Class II field actions affecting da Vinci 5 and SP components. These do not establish systemic product failure but raise the evidence threshold for a fully closed moat/quality assessment.

PwC opined that FY2025 financial statements were fairly presented in all material respects and that internal control over financial reporting was effective; Q2 2026 management also concluded disclosure controls were effective with no material ICFR change.

David J. Rosa is CEO and Gary S. Guthart is Executive Chair. The 2026 proxy states that 50% of long-term executive equity target is PSUs and 50% RSUs for the principal named executives; executive and director beneficial ownership was about 0.6% as a group.
The Q2 10-Q discloses multiple 10b5-1 plans, including Executive Chair Gary Guthart's May 7, 2026 plan; these should not be treated as discretionary bearish sales without transaction-level evidence.

The current higher-for-longer regime raises hospital capital-budget and valuation discount-rate pressure, while Intuitive's balance sheet materially limits refinancing risk. Macro is therefore a risk-budget/valuation overlay, not a company-quality score input.
